timeline.summary: The narrator explains that Duskmourn is both the world and the House.
timeline.quote: The House is the world, the world is the House, and the word for both is Duskmourn

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Welcome Home
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Welcome Home" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Flashback: the people of the plane, discontent with scarce magic, learned to summon hungry creatures from the void.
timeline.quote: The people of what became Duskmourn learned the art of summoning creatures from the lifeless void, beings of hunger and raw strength.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Welcome Home
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Welcome Home" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.quote: when it offered them a contract, they accepted. They paid its price, and it was finally free to feed.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Welcome Home
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Welcome Home" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Welcome Home" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Welcome Home" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The narrator reveals the guests are trapped by the chairs they sat in willingly, and that the House will take its first bites of them.
timeline.quote: if I can convince people not to fight it long enough for it to take the first few bites, it lets me keep my little space

citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Welcome Home" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.
